test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian music composers and singers, who is popular by nickname ‘the Mozart of Madras’, was placed in The Time’s list of the world’s most influential people in 2009?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AR Rahman.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A. R. Rahman: Mozart of Madras Isai Puyal.
 
• **Rahman**, in full **Allah Rakha Rahman,** original name A.S. Dileep Kumar, Indian composer whose extensive body of work for film and stage earned him the nickname** “the Mozart of Madras.”** Rahman's father, R.K.
 
• A R Rahman is an Indian Music **Director, Singer and also a Music producer. **
 
• He has** won many awards** till date and is a **popular face** in the Indian music industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manayangath Subramanian Viswanathan**, also known as** M.S.V., **was an Indian music director, singer and actor who predominantly worked in Tamil film industry.​ 
 
• **Shankar Mahadevan **is an Indian singer and composer who is part of the **Shankar–Ehsaan–Loy** composing trio team for Indian films.
 
• **Rahul Dev Burman** was an Indian music director. From the **1960s to the 1990s,** Burman composed musical scores for** 331 films.**
